reviewSamples.author: Photo of Billi Bob
reviewSamples.text: Love this place. Incredible & friendly vibe. I already found the place to complete my sleeve, and this is it. Everyone is super nice & professional; for starters they offer you water and/or coffee before they even begin business. They welcome, listen, and work with you step by step, which ultimately leads to an incredible tattoo.
